links.title: Result elements linked to the input "{{name}}"

route.skippedUnknown: the slot condition is not met
route.mayAddBlock: Can be added when the project is created

route.warnTitle: No person for a route step

sections.stub: The content of this section arrives in the next slice.

rules.title: Rules and reasons
rules.emptyLead: Pick a document, field, participant, point or route step to see why it is the way it is.
rules.studentHidden: Rules are hidden in the "As a student" mode.
rules.noTerms: No conditions: the rule sets an order.
rules.skippedNote: Not checked: the outcome was decided earlier.

builtin.nda_gate: The NDA rule is built into the engine: a document is switched off when the project has an NDA. It can be moved to the manifest later.
builtin.manuals_gate: The manuals rule is built into the engine: it reads the text of the "Manuals" field. It can be moved to the manifest later.
builtin.presentation_variant: The presentation variant choice is built into the engine. It can be moved to the manifest later.
builtin.builtin_route: The built-in signing order: neither the version nor the point set its own.
builtin.other: The rule is built into the engine and has no file.

chain.title: Rule chain
chain.empty: This element has no rules of its own.
chain.emptyDepends: Its state is changed by the inputs under "What if".
chain.emptyStatic: It does not depend on the inputs.

rules.stepNote: A step's chain is the route order and the decisions about the document and slot pairs of its people.

readers.title: What else this rule decides
readers.lead: Other elements the same decisions talk about.

rules.busy_one: The server is busy, retrying in {{count}} second.
rules.busy_other: The server is busy, retrying in {{count}} seconds.
rules.busyFailed: The server is busy, the reason did not load

impact.unknown: This version has no such input.
impact.inert: This input affects nothing: no section of the outcome changes with it.
impact.noLinks: In this combination the input's decisions are tied to no element. It changes the sections: {{sections}}.

footer.note: A calculation on test data, nothing is sent.

errors.title: Could not get the outcome
errors.versionMissingLead: The workspace has no version {{version}} of the {{template}} template. Pick another one in the version list.
errors.treeFailed: Could not load the workspace tree

drawer.title: Files
drawer.lead: Picking a file opens the Files mode: the editor with the Source and Form tabs.

phone.readOnly: Editing is available on a computer.

checks.pythonHint: Python rule: runs only at build time, not part of the instant calculation

off.disabled: the rule is turned off in the check settings
off.no_active_document: no such document in the set ({{documents}})

checks.noneApplicable: No rule applies to the documents of this combination.
checks.unavailableLead: The response came without check rules. Recalculate.
checks.emptyTitle: The version has no check rules

part.failedStale: Could not refresh the "{{name}}" section: showing the previous data

branches.variantsEmpty: The documents of this combination have no variants.
branches.variantLang: Unavailable variants exist only for a language other than {{lang}}.

branches.languageLead: Project language: {{lang}}. A document with no edition in it uses the template's default language.
branches.fallbackEmpty: Every document has an edition in the project language.
branches.unavailableLead: The response came without input details. Recalculate.
branches.emptyTitle: The result does not depend on the inputs
branches.emptyLead: No input changes the set, the participants, the points or the route.

workspace.title: Workspace branch
workspace.folder: A folder workspace without git: there is no branch or base, the result is computed from the working tree.
workspace.compareNote: The same fingerprint on a branch and on the base means the same result. The counts and fingerprints below are per section: compare them by switching "Outcome from" at the top.

scenarios.readOnlyState: Scenarios can be edited only when the result is read from the working tree
scenarios.readOnlyStudent: Scenarios cannot be edited in the "As a student" mode

empty.exampleVkr: Thesis: "NDA and only the programmer's manual"

dialog.createLead: The inputs and the example data set come from the screen.
dialog.duplicateLead: The copy gets a new file name and the same inputs, snapshot and assertions.
dialog.inputsNote_one: {{count}} input goes into the file, the rest use their defaults.
dialog.inputsNote_other: {{count}} inputs go into the file, the rest use their defaults.

fields.name: Name ({{lang}})
fields.nameRequired: Give a name in at least one language
fields.idHint: Latin letters, digits and dashes, for example company-supervisor
fields.idFormat: Lowercase Latin letters and digits with single dashes between them, up to 64 characters
fields.idTaken: A scenario with this file name already exists

versions.customHint: Comma separated; an asterisk stands for any ending, for example 2026.1.*

expect.title: Expected result
expect.snapshot: Remember a snapshot of the result
expect.snapshotHint: A run shows any difference from the snapshot: it catches everything but is noisy after every edit.
expect.refresh: Record the snapshot again from the current result
expect.assertions: Assertions: pointed expectations that survive unrelated edits

assertions.noResult: The result is not loaded yet, so there are no ready assertions.

document_state.absent: Document "{{doc}}" is not in the project

item_active.no: Item "{{doc}}" of point "{{point}}" is not active

route_pair.no: Signer "{{persona}}" is not in the route: document "{{doc}}", slot {{slot}}, point "{{point}}"

failure.title: Could not write the scenario
failure.staleLead: It was edited after you opened it. Refresh to see the current version, or save yours over it.
failure.missingLead: The file was deleted. Refresh the list.
failure.taken: A scenario with this file name already exists.
failure.offline: No connection to the server. The scenario was not written.
failure.server: The server could not write the scenario.
failure.busy: The server is busy calculating, try again in a moment.

panel.brokenTitle: The scenario file cannot be read
panel.passed: The result matches the snapshot and the assertions.
panel.unchecked: The scenario has no snapshot or assertions, it only shows the result.
panel.errorTitle: The scenario does not fit this version
panel.errorLead: The scenario inputs cannot be read on this version.
panel.noRun: The scenario has not been run yet.
panel.overridden: Inputs are changed on the screen: the snapshot is taken from the scenario's own inputs, not the changed ones.
panel.accept: Accept the current result as expected
panel.acceptHint: The new snapshot replaces the previous one. You can undo it within ten seconds.

saveInputs.title: Save the inputs into scenario "{{name}}"
saveInputs.lead: What is changed on the screen goes into the scenario file.
saveInputs.refresh: Update the snapshot for the new inputs
saveInputs.assertions: Assertions stay as they are: the run will show which ones stopped holding.

pale.none: No single input brings this in
pale.failed: Could not find an input, press again

student.label: Student view
student.summary: This is how the student's project looks with the chosen inputs.

documents.title: Documents
documents.empty: There are no documents in this combination.

fields.title: What to fill in
fields.lead: Required project fields and questionnaires the student has to fill in.

route.title: Who signs
route.lead: Signing order for each submission point.
route.empty: There are no signatures in this combination.

blocked.released: The version is released and immutable: editing is off.
blocked.state: Only the working tree can be edited: switch the state to Working tree.

confirm.noOutcome: The outcome is not loaded yet, so the number of affected elements is unknown.
confirm.none: In the current combination of inputs the rule decides no outcome element.
confirm.count_one: Affects {{count}} outcome element in the current combination.
confirm.count_other: Affects {{count}} outcome elements in the current combination.
confirm.scope: The number comes from the trace of the shown outcome; the server did not compute other input combinations. A deletion can be undone for 10 seconds, then from the edit history.

notice.driftTitle: The record changed after this edit
notice.driftLead: It was changed outside this screen or by another edit. Undo or redo will overwrite those changes.
notice.staleTitle: The file changed while you were editing
notice.staleLead: The record was reread from disk. Check the value and repeat the edit.
notice.missingTitle: The record is no longer in the manifest
notice.missingLead: The manifest was changed outside this screen. The model was reread; choose the element again.

title.undo: After the undo the outcome changed
title.redo: After the redo the outcome changed

live.saved: The edit is saved, the outcome is being recalculated.
live.delta: The outcome changed: {{added}} added, {{changed}} changed, {{removed}} removed.

preview.needWorkTree: The preview builds the working tree: pick “Working tree” in “Result from”.
preview.title: PDF preview
preview.lead: Built on test data, nothing is sent. The server builds the PDF.
preview.noDocument: The preview does not build this document.
preview.variantLangHint: Unavailable variants are greyed out: the project language is {{lang}}.
preview.variantNoPdf: This variant does not produce a PDF: the build will end without one.
preview.autoHint: Rebuild after the inputs, scenario or files change. Off until you turn it on.
preview.hint: Press “Build” to see the PDF. Auto-build rebuilds it after edits.
preview.staleFiles: Files changed after the build: the PDF may be out of date. Build again.
preview.staleInputs: The inputs, scenario or variant changed after the build: the PDF shows the earlier choice.
preview.quota: {{limit}} preview builds are already running, no more are allowed.
preview.cachedLead: From cache: a build with the same data already existed, the document was not built again.

failure.busyLead: Try again in {{seconds}} s. Calculations are rate limited: if the error stays, wait a minute.
failure.atlasLead: The table would have {{rows}} rows with a limit of {{limit}}. Pin some inputs: pinned values cut the table.
failure.atlasLeadPlain: Pin some inputs: pinned values cut the table.
failure.tooLargeLead: The answer would take {{size}} MiB with a limit of {{limit}} MiB. Choose fewer scenarios.
failure.tooLargeLeadPlain: The answer is over the limit. Choose fewer scenarios.

noBase.no_git: The workspace is a plain folder without git: it has neither a last commit nor a base.
noBase.no_base: The workspace has no base branch. Fetch it in the Files section or compare two scenarios.
noBase.new_version: This version is not on the base: it is new, so there is nothing to compare it with. Compare two scenarios.
noBase.unknown: The version is not on the base, or the workspace has no git.

failure.inputsTitle: The inputs do not fit the version
failure.rateLead: The linter is limited to 6 requests per minute. Retry in {{seconds}} s or wait a minute.

matrix.againstNoGit: Needs a workspace with git: a plain folder has no base
matrix.group: group {{letter}}: the section result is the same in these scenarios
matrix.legend: Cells: {{matched}} matched, {{changed}} changed, {{unchecked}} not checked, {{error}} with an error. The same letters in a column mean the scenarios do not differ in that section; the “~” mark means the section changed against the base.
matrix.emptyLead: Save the current inputs as a scenario, and after edits the Studio will show what changed.
matrix.noDiff: The section matches the expectation, no mismatch.
matrix.noDiffList: There is no detailed change list for this cell: open the scenario.
matrix.emptyBroken_one: No readable scenarios, one file has an error. Open the scenario list and fix it.
matrix.emptyBroken_other: No readable scenarios, {{count}} files have errors. Open the scenario list and fix them.

atlas.loading: Calculating the atlas, this may take a few seconds
atlas.cancelledLead: The atlas is not calculated. Calculate it again when you need it.
atlas.noDimensions: The result does not depend on inputs: there are no dimensions and the atlas has one row.
atlas.dimensionsLead: Inputs whose value changes something in the result. The rest are collected below under “No effect”.

reason.cosmetic: changes only file names, the edition language or document variants

atlas.searchPlaceholder: Search by value, input or outcome (key /)
atlas.noResults: Nothing found. Reset the search or filters.
atlas.detailNone: The current inputs are not in the table: some inputs are pinned to other values.
atlas.pinChooseLead: Choose the input values that need no enumeration: the atlas will be calculated again with fewer rows.

compare.identicalLead: The result on the left ({{left}}) and on the right ({{right}}) is the same in every section.
compare.identicalSame: Both sides are the same. Choose different scenarios, inputs or states.

impact.title: What changes in the result
impact.headChanged_one: The result will change in {{changed}} of {{total}} scenario
impact.headChanged_other: The result will change in {{changed}} of {{total}} scenarios
impact.headSame_one: The result will not change in the only scenario
impact.headSame_other: The result will not change in any of {{total}} scenarios
impact.headNoScenarios: The template has no scenarios: nothing to compare the result against
impact.atlas: Atlas: {{changed}} of {{total}} rows will change, outcomes {{before}} before and {{after}} after.
impact.atlasNull: The atlas is too large, compared by scenarios only.
impact.scenarioErrorPlain: The scenario cannot be read on one of the sides.
impact.loading: Computing the result on the base and in the work tree, {{seconds}} s...
impact.busyRetry: The server is busy, retrying in {{seconds}} s...
impact.busyLead: Retry in {{seconds}} s. Calculations are rate limited: if the error stays, wait a minute.
impact.tooLargeLead: The response exceeds the limit. Open Matrix and Compare on the Result screen to see differences per scenario.
impact.failedTitle: Could not compute before and after
impact.notBlocking: You can still propose the changes.

cancelled.title: Calculation cancelled
cancelled.lead: You can propose the changes without it.

released.title: The version is released and immutable
released.lead: Edits do not reach version {{version}}, so there is nothing to compare.

no_git.title: A folder without git
no_git.lead: The workspace has no last commit and no base, so there is nothing to compare with. You can propose the changes without a comparison.

no_base.title: No base
no_base.lead: The workspace has no base branch. Fetch it in the Files section and the comparison will appear here.

new_version.title: The version is new, nothing to compare
new_version.lead: This version is not on the base, so there is no "before". You can propose the changes without a comparison.

unknown.title: Nothing to compare with
unknown.lead: The version is not on the base, or the workspace has no git.

noScenarios.title: No scenarios
noScenarios.lead: Scenarios are checks of the result: without them a condition edit goes unnoticed. Create at least one.

impact.warning: The result of these scenarios will change. Review the differences above: a confirmation is required to continue.

pr.head_one: **The result will change in {{changed}} of {{total}} scenario**
pr.head_other: **The result will change in {{changed}} of {{total}} scenarios**
pr.headNone: Scenario results are unchanged ({{total}} in total)
pr.atlas: Atlas: {{changed}} of {{total}} rows will change, outcomes {{before}} before and {{after}} after

lint.title: Pack check
lint.loading: Checking the pack (a few seconds; the atlas rules take longer than the static ones)...
lint.busyRetry: The server is busy, retrying the check (attempt {{count}})...
lint.rateWait: Too many checks (limit 6 per minute). Retrying on its own in {{seconds}} s.
lint.cancelledLead: Run it again when you need it.
lint.stale: Showing the previous check result: a new one could not be fetched.
lint.released: The version is released and immutable: the check is read-only, fixes go into a new version.
lint.atlasSkippedTitle: The pack is too large for the atlas check
lint.atlasSkippedLead: Rules that enumerate combinations were skipped, only the static ones ran. Pin inputs in the Atlas view so the table fits the limit.
lint.emptyLead: The linter found no problems in the pack rules.
lint.noMatchLead: Relax the filters or clear the search.

jinja.running: Checking Jinja templates (sandbox render, takes longer)...
jinja.lead: Renders templates in a sandbox: slower, work tree only, at most 6 times a minute.
jinja.notWorkTree: Jinja is only checked in the work tree.
jinja.unavailable: Jinja templates are only checked in the work tree; the check did not run for this state.

badge.clean: Pack check: no errors or warnings

coverage.title: Rule coverage by scenarios
coverage.approximate: Coverage is approximate: the atlas is too large, the numbers are a lower bound.
coverage.rowsLabel: Combinations that close the most outcomes
